metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear the crosshair was just guessing LOL
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was smashing buttons randomly.
Enemy probably rebooting their PC right now.
Watch me act like this was all part of the plan.

Click if your aim’s chaos but you still get the kill!

Hit that if your aim’s a mystery but the kill’s guaranteed!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
